questions.question: Which UDHR article protects the right to seek, receive and impart information?
questions.explanation: Article 19 of the UDHR protects the right to seek, receive and impart information through any media.

questions.question: Which organisation publishes the annual World Press Freedom Index?
questions.explanation: Reporters Without Borders (RSF) publishes the annual World Press Freedom Index.

questions.question: What is an example of indirect (subtle) censorship?
options: Economic pressure such as withholding advertising revenue
questions.explanation: Indirect censorship includes economic pressure, legal intimidation (SLAPPs), regulatory capture and surveillance.

questions.question: Why is self-censorship described as the most insidious form of censorship?
options: It involves stories that are never written at all
It is always loud and visible
questions.explanation: Self-censorship is the most insidious form because it involves stories that are never written, leaving no visible trace.

questions.question: Which article of the Norwegian Constitution guarantees freedom of expression and prohibits prior censorship?
questions.explanation: Article 100 of the Norwegian Constitution guarantees freedom of expression and prohibits prior censorship.
